content.text: {"summary":"I estimated c as the average of -∂f/∂v at v=0. I took this average over q and u in [-1,1], counting which ReLU units are active. The result is about 0.42, both at the origin and averaged over the domain. I then used the two unused hidden units (4 and 5) to add exactly -c*v: unit 4 computes ReLU(v) with output weight -c, and unit 5 computes ReLU(-v) with output weight +c. All other weights are unchanged, so the drag, restoring and force responses are preserved.","estimated_c":0.42,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[4,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[4],"value":-0.42},{"tensor":"W1","index":[5,1],"value":-1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[5],"value":0.42}]}
